title: Ninjas PvP
description: Ninjas PvP is an economy-based semi-PvP SMP Minecraft server built for players who want a competitive and chill survival experience without losing the core vanilla feel.
body:
Ninjas PvP is an economy-based semi-PvP SMP Minecraft server built for players who want a competitive and chill survival experience without losing the core vanilla feel. The server features a player-driven economy where trading, grinding, and smart decision-making matter.

This is not a heavily restricted server—Ninjas PvP embraces semi-PvP gameplay, meaning minimal rules and maximum freedom. There is no pay-to-win mechanics, keeping progression fair and rewarding.

If you’re looking for a server where your choices actually matter and every encounter can change your standing, Ninjas PvP delivers a balanced mix of chaos and competition.
